upstream.source_data: Stage 01 class imbalance ratio (16.94% positive clicks) + Stage 14 validation protocol.
upstream.inherited_features: Model probability outputs across positive/negative click events.
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: ROC-AUC is overly optimistic under class imbalance; PR-AUC directly penalizes false positive bid costs.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: When negative impressions vastly outnumber clicks, False Positives inflate True Negative rate, artificially inflating ROC-AUC. PR-AUC focuses exclusively on the minority positive class.

downstream.hand_off_contract: Calculates PR-AUC = 0.1749 (baseline 0.1694) and optimal F1 threshold tau* = 0.22.

adtech_role.business_impact: Balances ad impression yield against wasted bid spend by selecting the profit-maximizing classification threshold for CPA campaigns.
